group.status: PB1 neutral vectors; data only; validated without loading either stack

given: The local receiving authority boundary denies a request
when: The host records the attempted Execution
then: No Channel frame is emitted
No far-side effect occurs
A complete observation is still produced

given: A Constraint value at version 2 adds narrowing semantics
when: The request presents that authority position
then: The value is not projected, because projection would discard narrowing and widen authority
The atom is Unknown and the request is denied
No frame crosses a pre-provider boundary

when: The target evaluates the request structurally
then: The expression is True
The request may proceed

when: The target evaluates the request structurally
then: The expression is Unknown
Unknown never resolves to permitted
The request is denied without a far-side effect

when: A request body contains a Capability, Constraint expression, or derivation chain
then: The authority presentation fails closed
No provider effect begins

given: The realization crosses a declared trust boundary
when: The contract omits the no-capability-transfer declaration
then: Negotiation fails closed rather than defaulting to a permissive mode

given: The Operation declares the host-context Fragment as required
then: The request is refused before provider activation
Attribution is not inferred from delivery

given: The plan negotiated the copied-immutable-blob flavor
The resource declares a SHA-256 content hash
when: The request carries the resource and the hash verifies
then: The provider receives an independent immutable copy
No release signal is required
The observation records ownership 'copied' and the realization's copy count

given: A copied-immutable-blob resource declares a content hash
when: The received octets hash to a different value
then: The resource is refused before any provider effect
The mismatch is not reported as a successful negotiation

given: The plan negotiated the addressing-only-handle flavor with a declared accept list
when: A request carries a handle inside that list
then: The handle conveys addressing only
The provider domain still performs its own admission
No octets cross and the copy count stays zero

given: The plan declares which handles are accepted
when: A request carries a handle outside that list
then: The resource is refused before any provider effect
The portable category is invalid-payload and the local code 'resource-refused' stays non-normative
The refusal is not an authority decision, because a handle carries no authority

given: Borrowed read-only regions and transferred ownership are 0.1 non-goals
then: Negotiation fails closed
There is no fallback and no silent downgrade to the copied flavor

given: The addressing-only-handle flavor permits no copy at all
when: A frame carries resource octets for a handle-flavored resource
then: The frame is refused rather than silently materializing a copy
The copy count remains zero
The bound is enforced before uncontrolled work
No partial provider effect begins

given: The copied-immutable-blob flavor requires no release signal and defines none
when: A frame carries a release signal for that resource
then: The frame is refused rather than treated as a harmless no-op
